jobs.description:
FOUR PAWS is the global animal welfare organisation for animals under direct human influence, which reveals suffering, rescues animals in need and protects them. Find out more about our sustainable campaigns and projects on https://www.vier-pfoten.at/?_jtsuid=94762174222303860670658 and https://www.four-paws.org/.

Would you like to contribute to something meaningful and work with us on our mission? This is your chance. We are looking for dedicated people to enrich our team. 1 Team Lead Major Gifts and Legacy Fundraising (Team Driver) Your contribution will be

 * Lead and manage the team of Major Donor, Mid-Level Donor and Legacy Fundraisers at FOUR PAWS Austria on both strategic and operational levels

 * Develop and implement Leadership Giving strategies, processes and fundraising plans, including donor acquisition, cultivation, stewardship and retention strategies

 * Collaborate closely with national and international teams particularly across the DACH region to ensure effective information sharing

 * Drive the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Leadership Giving

 * Manage budgets, KPIs and reporting for Leadership Giving activities

 * Represent FOUR PAWS Austria at partner, networking and events

 * Play a key role in annual fundraising planning and ensure successful implementation of agreed fundraising initiatives

 * Oversee complex donor cases and support the team in strategic donor cultivation, stewardship and relationship management

Your profile ideally illustrates

 * Several years of experience in fundraising, ideally in major gifts or leadership giving

 * Fluency in German and strong English language skills

 * Leadership experience with the ability to motivate, coach and develop high-performing teams.

 * Strong presentation and communication skills

 * Passion for animal welfare and commitment to FOUR PAWS' mission

Our offer includes

 * The opportunity to truly contribute to global animal welfare

 * An international, dynamic work environment

 * Flexible and family-friendly working arrangements including the option of partial remote work

 * A dog-friendly workplace

 * Workplace health and wellbeing initiatives

 * Wiener Linien annual ticket (or partial contribution to Klima Ticket) and pension fund after probationary period

 * PAWSdays: extra days off at the end of the year on top of your annual leave

 * Birthday leave: extra day off to use around your birthday

 * The minimum gross annual salary for this position starts at 52,000 EUR (full-time base, consisting of 14 payments), in accordance with our internal compensation scheme

 

At FOUR PAWS we stand up for animal welfare worldwide by empowering everyone to contribute their unique and authentic experiences and to show compassion for animals, people, and the planet. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a workplace built on equity, inclusion, and belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities who share our passion for creating a better world for animals. 

Please note that in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, having a valid work permit for the respective country or being eligible to obtain one is a requirement for this position prior to commencing employment. 

Join our passionate team to make a difference for animals. Apply with your CV in English or German today.

As Ground Safety Expert you`ll own risk management and assurance processes across ground safety, including dangerous goods.  * Be accountable for the quality, integrity and regulatory compliance of the risk data and recommendations you produce, in line with IOSA ISARPs and DHA standards.

Your Qualifications:

 * Working knowledge of EU aviation safety regulations, AOC operations specifications and operations manual requirements.
 * A sound grasp of statistical principles and confidence working with data and trends.
 * Fluent in English, strong MS Office skills and the interpersonal skills to build effective relationships across the business.

jobs.description:
1 Experienced Software Engineer (f/m/d) for Industrial Vision Systems-JOB ID: 270960     CENTER FOR VISION, AUTOMATION & CONTROL
 * You are the senior technology expert for Software Development, driving innovation, and making strategic technical decisions, that ensure the success of our research and industry projects.
 * You develop software that complies with the newest standards regarding software security, especially compliance with the EU's cyber resilience act.
 * You design software architectures for reliable, expandable and maintainable vision systems.
 * You select the right approaches to scale our technology from rapid spike development to systems that run around the clock in industrial facilities.
 * You advance our software development with a high dedication to quality and a high commitment to well-tested and documented applications.
 * You also share your expertise with junior developers, offering strategic guidance in software requirements analysis, system design and structuring modular tasks.
 * With your interest in the newest technological developments, you advance our research projects and help establish new business models and concepts in the field of advanced vision systems.
 * Driven by a practical-problem solving approach, you develop industrial solutions that excel in performance, reliability and innovation.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:
 * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field
 * At least 5 years of relevant industrial software development experience, with a high level of commitment and proven ability to work in a team, preferably a similar field
 * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate efficiently with clients and project managers, and to guide a development team
 * Strong skills in modern C++ and Python, with solid experience in Git, CMake and Linux environments. Experience with Qt/PySide, C#/.NET, MATLAB, CUDA or HPC is beneficial.
 * Experience with software architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, Docker, documentation and secure development practices.
 * Experience with AI-assisted development and coding agents for implementation, refactoring, testing, documentation and code review. Ability to critically validate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability.
 * Knowledge of sensing and camera technology as well as factory automation of advantage
 * Good command of English and German (both required)

What to expect:
 * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 68.152,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, pension fund, additional days off for various life events, family benefits (including two weeks of paid paternity leave "Papa-Weeks" and leisure subsidies), voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events and many more, as well as flexitime models (incl. up to 50% home office), travel support for conferences and networking, and individual training and career development opportunities.

 At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.
